class.name: OpenWorldTreePlacementData
class.brief_description: Compact persistent placement records for a group of trees.
class.description: [OpenWorldTreePlacementData] stores parallel packed arrays used by [OpenWorldTree3D]. Positions and transforms are local to the tree node. Stable instance IDs and enabled flags allow a gameplay system to temporarily remove one tree from static rendering without changing the IDs of remaining trees.

method.name: add_tree
method.description: Adds a tree and returns its stable instance ID. A negative [param variant_index] selects a variation deterministically from [param seed].

method.name: find_index_by_id
method.description: Returns the packed-array index for [param instance_id], or [code]-1[/code] when it is not present.

method.name: get_instance
method.description: Returns all fields for one placement record.

method.name: get_instance_count
method.description: Returns the number of placement records, including disabled records.

method.name: get_instance_transform
method.description: Returns the local transform for one placement record.

method.name: is_instance_enabled
method.description: Returns whether a placement participates in static tree rendering.

method.name: remove_tree_at
method.description: Permanently removes the placement at [param index]. Prefer disabling a tree when gameplay may restore it later.

method.name: set_instance_enabled
method.description: Controls whether the placement participates in static tree rendering.

members.member: Per-instance colors exposed to shaders as [code]INSTANCE_COLOR[/code].
Per-instance shader data exposed as [code]INSTANCE_CUSTOM[/code], for example wind phase and tint controls.
One byte per tree. Zero hides the tree from static rendering.
Stable IDs used by save data and future interaction systems.
Local positions. This array defines the placement count.
Local scales. Uniform scale is recommended for trees that may later become interactive.
Deterministic per-instance seeds used for automatic variant selection.
Explicit variation index per tree. Negative values request deterministic selection from the seed.
